text:
leo-finance: Heads-up: vendor MarketPulse GmbH (vendor_id MP-900) sent INV-2026-1101 dated 2026-01-10. They charged German VAT via OSS and also asked for a W-8BEN-E to avoid US withholding. PO 7044 is under Redwood Ltd (GB). Can someone triage the VAT/W-8 confusion?
anna-procurement: Which entity is invoice addressed to?
leo-finance: Invoice addressed to Redwood, Inc (US) but PO is for Redwood Ltd (GB). Snippet:```Invoice INV-2026-1101
Vendor: MarketPulse GmbH (DE)
VAT: DE123456789
Service: Market research datasets (Dec 2025)
Net: 10,000.00 EUR
OSS VAT (EU OSS) 19% = 1,900.00 EUR
Total = 11,900.00 EUR
Note: VAT charged under OSS scheme.```
maria-legal: Two immediate flags: 1) If the PO is under Redwood Ltd we should be invoiced to the UK entity (GB VAT id on PO). 2) OSS is a VAT collection mechanism for distance sales/one-off B2C sales across EU using the seller's OSS registration; it is not the usual method for B2B services to a VAT-registered business. Asking for W-8BEN-E is odd — that's for foreign entities claiming US treaty benefits.
tax-bot: Automated check: Vendor MP-900 country=DE. PO entity=Redwood Ltd (GB987654321). MarketPulse indicates OSS use — possible they treat the sale as B2C or marketplace-handled. We have no W-8/W-9 on vendor file. Guidance: For B2B services to a UK VAT-registered customer, vendor should either not charge DE VAT (reverse charge) or invoice under OSS only if sale is judged to be consumer-facing. We should request reissue: address to Redwood Ltd, include our GB VAT, or provide explanation why OSS applied. W-8BEN-E is not required for a German supplier billing a UK customer; only relevant if US entity pays them and tax treaty claims apply.
marketpulse-billing: (vendor reply) "Hi Redwood billing, we billed via OSS because our sales team thought dataset delivery was to a US entity and OSS simplifies EU VAT on digital supplies. We also asked for a W-8BEN-E because our US finance asked for a form when dealing with US clients. We'll re-evaluate"
anna-procurement: Placed invoice ON_HOLD in AP. :no_entry_sign: Please ask vendor to reissue to Redwood Ltd (GB987654321) and remove OSS VAT or explain legal basis (i.e., that sale is to a consumer or marketplace intermediary).
leo-finance: Draft message to vendor:```Hi MarketPulse billing,
PO 7044 is to Redwood Ltd (VAT GB987654321). Please reissue the invoice addressed to Redwood Ltd and either remove the OSS VAT (if this is a B2B supply) or provide legal justification for OSS treatment (e.g., customer classification as a consumer, marketplace agent declaration). Also no W-8BEN-E is required for a German supplier billing a UK company; please confirm whether payment will be processed by Redwood, Inc and if so we can discuss US tax reporting. Payment will remain on hold until we receive a corrected invoice and supporting documentation.
Best, Leo (Finance)```
maria-legal: Add: request screenshot of OSS declaration/reporting so we have audit trail if they insist. If they continue to charge VAT incorrectly, procurement should escalate.
marketpulse-billing: (vendor reply) "Thanks, we'll reissue to Redwood Ltd and remove OSS VAT if you provide your GB VAT number on the invoice. We thought the buyer was outside EU so we used OSS. We'll attach OSS filing screenshot if needed."
tax-bot: Note for records: If MarketPulse later insists payment came from a Redwood US entity and claims US withholding exposure, ask for a W-8BEN-E only if they claim treaty benefits for US-source income; otherwise W-8 is irrelevant. Also if they remit OSS-collected VAT to German authorities, retain the OSS filing evidence for audit.
ap-bot: Invoice INV-2026-1101 status -> ON_HOLD at 2026-01-11T09:20:00Z by leo-finance.
leo-finance: Vendor reissued 2026-01-11 14:02 CET: new invoice addressed to Redwood Ltd with GB VAT included and note 'reverse charge' removed OSS VAT line; net unchanged. Attached OSS filing screenshot showing initial submission and a short note: 'Incorrect route used; reissued.'
anna-procurement: AP to process once reissued invoice is uploaded to Coupa and matched to PO 7044. Removing hold after verification.
maria-legal: Keep both original and reissued invoice plus OSS screenshot in vendor file for audit trail. If OSS-collected VAT was actually remitted, procurement/tax should coordinate for any reclaim or adjustments.
leo-finance: Thanks all — marking as resolved after AP clears the reissued invoice.
